rationale.ai-code-insecurity: Five LLMs produced exploitable CWE-linked bugs in 48% of snippets.
rationale.rules-based-checks: ESBMC deterministically checked generated snippets for safety violations.
rationale.formal-methods: Classical model checking verified generated C code against safety properties.
rationale.automation-bias: Synthesizes evidence that capable programmers over-trust insecure AI-generated code.
rationale.org-governance: Allocates security responsibilities across developers, organizations, and policymakers.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Applies NIST cybersecurity frameworks and secure-by-design guidance to AI code.
